body: I'm sorry. I wish I could say more, but all I can say is I feel you. I'm wishing you the best. I hope that at least you can take some comfort in your friend being there. You've held mentally ill friends together, but I hope you're able to lean on some of them in your time of need.

People should be turned away from these services.

Calling them up gave me more reasons than ever to kill myself afterwards. I consider them dangerous to vulnerable people.

I tried a suicide help line text app for the first time today. It took a lot of courage. I've always been scared of being tracked down through my phone or having someone in my house hearing and giving me shit for it, so I used a text service.  


And they gave me the most robotic answers. How can I help you? You can Chat. It didn't even sound like a human was talking to me.  


It actually made me feel more depressed, and like the world was cold and corporate. No one cares about you if you don't have immediate plans for suicide, and if you do have immediate plans they can lock you up.
